sources.title: GitHub - lucidrains/CoCa-pytorch: Implementation of CoCa, Contrastive ...
sources.snippet: CoCa - Pytorch Implementation of CoCa, Contrastive Captioners are Image-Text Foundation Models, in Pytorch. They were able to elegantly fit in contrastive learning to a conventional encoder / decoder (image to text) transformer, achieving SOTA 91.0% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with a finetuned encoder.
